scope: Corollary 5.5 (Supply of successful labels) of the manuscript “Ground-state condensation in the dilute hard-sphere gas” (preprints/Ground-state-condensation-in-the-dilute-hard-sphere-gas-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3f861f3b57ec1d6a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 25-26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Consider a collection of deterministic torus paths with endpoints (yj, zj), and fix a cell v. Suppose that at most H1D of these paths visit the ball of radius 12 about v, and that every visiting path is regular. Suppose a list of m ≥ ℓD/2 labels satisfies 25 yi ∈ Bv, |zi − v| ≤ 3, and that both endpoints of every listed label are at distance greater than s0 from every other endpoint in the corresponding full configuration. Call a trial for label i successful if it satisfies Cv and avoids every obstacle path except the original path of i. For sufficiently small fixed t > 0 and then sufficiently large D, at least 9m/10 listed labels have the following property: for each of the seven target cells B, the set Ti,B = {u ∈ B : Qu yi,zi (successful trial) ≥ 9/10} (5.11) has volume at least 99/100. All choices are uniform in the deterministic collection, v, and α ∈ [α0/2, 2α0].
